main_text.l: nisi ob incurrentes inextricabiles difficultates, quales hic
nullæ apparent. Non tanquam ad inferiorem, quia ad
inferiorem non fit remissio, nisi ad molestias superiore
indignas evitandum, quales etiam hoc loco minime ap-
parent. Præterea revera populum Christianum Syno-
dus ludos fecit. Etenim postulatum calicis primitus ad
Papam delatum, ille ad Synodum rejecit. Synodus peti-
tionem justam, sex integros prius menses agitatam, dein
ad accuratiorem disquisitionem duos iterum menses di-
latam, postliminio ad Pontificem remisit. cum sine tan-
ti temporis jactura, absque tot officiis ac laboribus in
ipso statim principio ad ipsum remitti potuerit. Unde
publica querela sonabat, conditionem Christianorum
esse juxta prophetiam Esaiæ: Manda, remanda. Expecta,
reexpecta. Denique alii non erubuerunt levato velo dicere
quod res est, nimirum Synodum hoc decreto haud
obscure fallam esse, rationes eas, quibus calix à nonnul-
lis negatus est, idoneas & sufficientes haud esse. Nam si
dioneas judicâssent, in prohibitione perseverandum
fuisse. Si dubias, in examine
perpendum.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (winged cherub with cross-like finials) between the text and the catchword is not transcribed. The word "perpendum" is printed as "gendum" at the line start; reading "gendum" as printed in the scan, with the line "fuisse. Si dubias, in examine per" above it. The passage has a few doubtful readings: "dioneas" and "judicâssent" (printed "judicâffent") and "gendum" are as printed.
